title: A revocation that redeems pool shares from several liquidity pools gets one liquidity_pool_revoked effect, which can cite another pool's claimable balance

target.versions_affected: v30.0.1 and main 01ba44a (internal/ingest/processors/ is the same in both; range not established)

severity_basis: addLiquidityPoolRevokedEffect uses only the first liquidity pool change of the operation, so a revocation that redeems pool shares from several pools (CAP-38) gets one liquidity_pool_revoked effect and the other pools' reserve debits are written nowhere; the claimable balances are matched by asset alone, so the one effect written can cite another pool's claimable balance. Wrong and missing historical effects on pubnet; balances and current state are not affected.

entries.expected: one liquidity_pool_revoked effect per pool whose shares the operation redeems, each citing the claimable balance created for that pool's reserve
entries.observed: Not run by the kit against Horizon (Horizon has no replay adapter in this kit). By hand at v30.0.1 on pubnet ledger 55568683, transaction cfe5afa4…: its four AllowTrust operations redeem pool shares 9 times across 6 pools and Horizon writes 4 effects; in operation 1 the effect for pool 07fbafb9… cites claimable balance 00000000f2dfbb49… (the d7ac80ee… redemption) instead of 00000000d8c94440….

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs, with the reproduction in the upstream issue; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. Horizon v30.0.1 rows for pubnet ledger 55568683, transaction cfe5afa41074ab428e2f4440f7b06895a90dacd5e2cb1aa2596fd234e3946f6c: 4 liquidity_pool_revoked effects where the operation meta shows 9 pool redemptions, 10 reserve debits not reported, and one effect citing the wrong claimable balance; git diff v30.0.1 main -- internal/ingest/processors/ is empty.
evidence.expected_basis: CAP-38 (https://github.com/stellar/stellar-protocol/blob/master/core/cap-0038.md): a revocation redeems the trustor's shares of every pool with the revoked asset, each reserve into its own claimable balance; the operation meta has one LIQUIDITY_POOL change per redeemed pool.

reproduction.method: The rows the issue reports, from Horizon v30.0.1 ingesting pubnet ledger 55568683, read before filing on 2026-11-19 against the LIQUIDITY_POOL changes in each operation's meta.

queries: stellar/stellar-horizon: every issue and pull request title, open and closed
stellar/stellar-horizon: commits since 2026-11-01 on every branch touching internal/ingest/processors/

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-19: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-19 as https://github.com/stellar/stellar-horizon/issues/266; this record restates the public issue.
